bootstrap_summary.labels_scope: Historical TRAIN only; 22 successful-context actor teachers, all 6,144 outcomes for critic. Not fresh TEST results.

gate.scope: Protocol/controls completion only; no minimum capture or timestep-convergence gate

action.board_heading: Derived by the geometry provider to face the bucket; not a sixth learned output
action.invalid_action: Reject inadmissible bounds/IK/collision/setup actions; never substitute another shot or search flights at TEST
action.release_center: [board_x,board_y,board_height+gap+ball_radius]; vertical gap is above board center plane

actor.loader: PyTorch torch.load(path,map_location="cpu",weights_only=True); from checkpoint["policy"] select actor.* entries, strip the actor. prefix, and load into Sequential(Linear(9,64),Tanh(),Linear(64,64),Tanh(),Linear(64,5)). Evaluate in eval/no_grad mode; apply tanh to the five output means.

capture_contract.success: Board bounce, whole-ball entry and one continuous second retained. Rim-assisted captures count; clean is separate.

portable_policy_contract.required_external_geometry: Caller supplies target bucket XY and geometry-only admitted anchor bucket XY/five anchor action values. No raw prior joint bank is exported; checkpoints alone are not a complete arm setup resolver.
portable_policy_contract.scope: Fixed64 warm-start ablation: 6,144 historical TRAIN requests and 22 successful-context teachers bootstrap BC; PPO adds 1,024 fresh TRAIN requests. Twelve fresh VAL layouts select a frozen milestone; four methods get one nominal shot at each of 50 fresh TEST positions. Privileged geometry, prescribed held endpoints and geometry-only setup resolution, without ball-flight search at TEST. Not equal-acquisition-budget algorithm superiority, noise robustness, 128-substep qualification, all-table coverage, learned grasp/transit, perception or physical validation. Historical 128 failures are unchanged.
portable_policy_contract.training_only: Critic, optimizer and logstd are retained in original audited checkpoints; deterministic evaluation uses only the actor mean followed by tanh.

privacy: Nominal TEST geometry, scalar outcomes, model checkpoints and hashes only. No raw prior joints, poses, contact arrays, trajectories, host paths or credentials. Checkpoints copied unchanged only after their exact bytes passed the independent audit; the exporter never unpickles them.

protocol.selection: Fresh VAL captures, then mean calibrated reward, then earliest milestone; frozen before TEST
